'''18,780 before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] ([[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]])''' was a year in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]]. The era, having begun more than [[20,000 BBY/Legends|1,000 years earlier]], featured growth and settlement out from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and into the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] areas "east" of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] center. On the Core [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Shawken]], an [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy|iconic]] [[Shawken Spire|edifice]] that reached low-[[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] altitude in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was destroyed. The building was later rebuilt, and its construction and destruction were honored by the historian [[Vicendi]] nearly [[10,000 BBY|9,000 years later]].

==Proem==
At least [[28,000 BBY|three thousand years prior]] to the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the inhabitants of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shawken]] began a construction project on a new building. This building became known as the [[Shawken Spire]], and during the span of over 9,000 years, it grew evermore towering. All the while, the Republic was [[Unification Wars (Galactic Republic)|established and unified]] and grew through settlement and annexation during the [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]] and the beginning portions of the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]].<ref name="EA" />

==The galaxy in 18,780 BBY==
By 18,780 BBY, the Great Manifest Period was more than 1,000 years in the making. The Republic continued its expansion eastward into the uncharted [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] areas of what later became "[[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]." In the Core, the Shawken Spire had become a super-tall structure that reached low-[[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] altitude. Made of ancient building materials, the building was famous across the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The iconic construct, however, met its destruction at this time.<ref name="EA" />

==Impact==
The Great Manifest Period continued for nearly [[17,018 BBY|2,000 more years]], as the Republic continued its expansion. On Shawken, the renowned Spire was later rebuilt with more modern materials. The original structure, however, retained its fame and was included in a [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy|list of galactic wonders]] composed by the historian [[Vicendi]] in his [[10,000 BBY]] publication ''[[Arturum Galactinum]]''.<ref name="EA" />

==Notable events==
*The Shawken Spire, a super-tall structure on Shawken that reached low-orbit altitude, was destroyed.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The year 18,780 BBY receives its only [[canon]]ical mention in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' in reference to the destruction of the Shawken Spire. The year, however, is also indirectly referred to by the labeling of the time period known as the Great Manifest Period from [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] to [[17,000 BBY]] in the ''Atlas''.<ref name="EA" />
